issues.title: Registration welcome and next step
issues.details: Requested by user: dedicated welcome after registration for personal and company accounts. Only generic dashboard greeting currently.

issues.title: Fresh company onboarding immediately says unsaved changes
issues.details: Immediately after registration, before any input on onboarding type, page shows unsaved changes twice. Default values seeded from registration should not imply the user edited unsaved data. Screenshot 06.

issues.title: Onboarding exposes seven steps even when data is already provided
issues.details: Company data and business profile prefilled/completed, but seven-step navigation with multiple future optional sections makes a simple registration feel long. Evaluate one concise setup + optional enrichment.

issues.title: Onboarding grid changes between type and details
issues.details: User observed live /onboarding/?step=type vs details. Source OnboardPage applies detailsLayout and removes aside only on details; form width and alignment jump. Need stable frame, step navigation, content width and footer across all steps.

issues.title: Product photo caption overflows into form column
issues.details: User screenshot confirms Georgian ფოტო არასავალდებულოა spills out of narrow photo column toward product code field. Need wrapping/min-width rules and consistent responsive product form.

issues.title: Spreadsheet import dominates single-product creation
issues.details: Large import instructions and technical limits appear before first product. Single product add should lead; import can expand on demand.
issues.currentAcceptance: Later user preference supersedes collapse: compact import remains visible, with short instructions, no permanent product quota, one template and one chooser.

issues.title: Verification submission leaves contradictory instructions
issues.details: After successful submission status is განსახილველი, but wizard still says გაგზავნამდე შეამოწმეთ and unsaved changes. Server-persisted verification status is treated as unsaved form editing.

issues.title: Verification has nested progress and ambiguous exits
issues.details: Desktop verification screen shows outer 7-step flow, inner 3-step document tabs, right completion meter, top skip-to-finish and multiple გადით actions. After pending, user still sees 4/7 despite action completed. Simplify one primary next action, label optional/skipped steps accurately, distinguish leave setup from sign out.

issues.title: Company review repeats name without field labels
issues.details: Review company section prints trading name and identical legal name twice, plus person/city/registration code without labels. Collapse equal names and label differing values. Screenshot 14.

issues.title: Upgrade company nested grid compresses form and actions
issues.details: In personal account settings, CompanyUpgrade uses another FormLayout with benefits aside inside the narrow account content column. At desktop the company field is ~210px, supporting paragraph becomes a tall narrow column, and footer buttons crowd. Screenshot16. Use single column within account card.

issues.title: Personal name duplicated as company in profile settings
issues.details: Fresh personal registration without company shows personal name in Company / Organization field and twice in profile preview. Do not invent company identity from personal name.

issues.title: Final request review truncates entered description
issues.details: Review shows two lines ending ellipsis with no expand control. User must go back to edit to verify full text before publishing. Show full description or expand. Screenshot21.

issues.title: Request review and preview use different missing-photo treatment
issues.details: Final review has gray image icon while right preview uses themed photo. Shared fallback treatment should be consistent. Screenshot21.

issues.title: Underlined navigation links remain in offer flow
issues.details: Offer page breadcrumbs, repeated request title links and return link still use default underlines, inconsistent with requested link treatment. Screenshot28.

issues.title: Offer cards emphasize incomparable unit and total prices
issues.details: Same buyer list shows 100 per unit vs 450 total without calculated 400 total on first card. Comparison page can normalize, but primary list should show total for quantity4 and unit price secondary. Screenshot31.

issues.title: Term differences appear below confirmation action
issues.details: Buyer receives changed price400→380, but change history/diff is below the confirm block. Show latest changes next to proposed terms and before acceptance. Supplier proposing own terms must separately confirm; consolidate with explicit combined wording if intent is unchanged. Screenshot37.

issues.title: Fulfillment timeline labels next unreported step as current delivered
issues.details: Supplier submitted only მზადაა გადასაცემად. Buyer timeline marks გადაცემულია as მიმდინარე though delivery was never reported. Distinguish reported current state from upcoming step. Screenshot42.

issues.title: Comparison table and repeated cards create excessive vertical length
issues.details: User still observes spacing and table problems. Comparison table uses wide cells and repeats same values in full offer cards beneath. Align sizing to information density and avoid duplicated details; verify on desktop and mobile. Screenshot32.

issues.title: Completed deal primary rating action is buried under history
issues.details: After completion, long fulfillment timeline, updates and resolved issue precede completion summary and rating CTA. Put success summary and next action near title; keep history collapsible. Screenshot44.

issues.title: Unselected rating stars have weak contrast
issues.details: Unselected star controls use approx #d9d9d9 on white (about1.4:1). The four required rating rows initially look empty; selected state must not be required to discover controls. Screenshot45 stable.

issues.title: Admin offer table squeezes company and request columns
issues.details: At desktop width, description and action columns dominate; company/request wrap to many short lines with underlines. Pagination shown twice even with two rows. Screenshot51.

issues.title: Simplify interface text and remove repeated instructions
issues.details: User requirement: review all critical flows for concise Georgian text, clear action labels and progressive disclosure. Keep decision-critical price, privacy, verification and irreversible-action information.
issues.verificationScope: Profile, account password, onboarding idle states and reviewed request/offer/contact copy. Required stars replace repeated optional labels; critical privacy, upload limits and result notices remain.

issues.title: Content publish stays enabled without edits
issues.details: Content editor says no changes but both publish actions remain enabled. Screenshot54; publishing not invoked.

issues.title: Audit-history search and period only filter current page
issues.details: UI explicitly says search/time filter only the 25 loaded entries; can report no result although matching older action exists. Server-wide filtering needed. Screenshot57.

issues.title: Notifications and messages need typography and grid review
issues.details: User reports oversized text and uncomfortable box layout. Inspect header dropdown, notifications page and message composer on desktop/mobile, including action destinations and read/unread behavior. Confirmed screenshot60: timestamp takes separate wide column while title truncated before supplier, grouped-offer heading huge and repeated, mixed card/list layouts. Move time below and simplify hierarchy.

issues.title: Contact-change requests are filed as complaints
issues.details: A normal profile contact-change enters Complaints, adds complaint count, and is described as complaint for admin. Separate account-change task semantics and clear pending state needed. Screenshot67.

issues.title: Contact email vs login email semantics differ between user and admin
issues.details: User contact-change dialog describes phone/email as account identifiers, while admin says only profile contact email changes and login email stays unchanged. User must see this distinction before submitting.

issues.title: Reopen confirmation promises seven days but request still shows fourteen
issues.details: Request closed then reopened. Confirmation says accepts offers for 7 days; resulting buyer/supplier view shows14 days and original Oct28 expiry. Need align operation and copy. Screenshot69.

issues.title: Resubmitting a withdrawn offer requires all information again
issues.details: After cancellation the promised resubmit path opens a blank form, losing access to prior description, price, delivery and terms. Offer reuse option would meet no-repeat-entry requirement.

issues.title: Mobile filter tabs wrap into bulky button grid
issues.details: User screenshot16:06 confirms notifications filters use two rows of large buttons; use one horizontally scrollable tab row with visible overflow affordance, selected state and keyboard focus. Audit all equivalent account/catalog/admin tab bars.

issues.title: Mobile navigation and overlay placement require functional audit
issues.details: User asks dropdown direction, edge fitting, information visibility, state retention, and potential bottom quick nav. Verify overlays flip/fit, close/focus behavior, background scroll lock, sticky action conflicts, back retention. Assess bottom nav against form footer and keyboard.

issues.title: Unsent message is lost when closing mobile conversation
issues.details: Type an unsent message, press Back, reopen same conversation: composer is empty without warning. Preserve per-thread draft across navigation, including attachments where supported.

issues.title: Mobile admin offers lose field labels and alignment
issues.details: Exact page /admin/?tab=offers&q=2981: table-to-card styling removes headers but shows no per-field labels; request links center while company links left; status/action misaligned; huge filter region and duplicate pager for three records. Screenshots79/80.

issues.title: Products optional; do not foreground product quota
issues.details: Latest owner instruction: company may have no products or provide services only. No required catalog or quota pressure, no constant 0/15 or limit copy. Preserve previously agreed 15-product cap; explain only when adding would exceed it. Do not treat optional missing products as registration failure.

issues.title: Progressive onboarding must allow useful completion with missing optional data
issues.details: Owner requires minimal registration, explicit add-later actions, retained progress and a clear successful endpoint. Products, services, gallery and verification documents may be added later. Preserve actual gating for verification-dependent actions, explain locally instead of trapping user in incomplete onboarding.

issues.title: Manually verified company still receives missing-verification crosses
issues.details: Review screen says verified but lists legal data/documents with failure crosses after admin manual verification. Avoid presenting optional outstanding documents as verification failure; status authority and next action must agree. Screenshot83.

issues.title: Admin funnel must distinguish completion, deferral and abandonment
issues.details: Owner requests visibility of last stage reached and later return. Track registration complete separately from company profile, verification and first business action; expose last activity, optional-step deferred vs errors, resumed users. No-products or missing optional documents must not count as failed signup. Never collect raw field values or passwords in analytics.

issues.title: Cancelled deal retains selected-supplier request wording
issues.details: After deal cancellation, admin request shows supplier selected and chosen offer alongside cancelled deal. Cancellation copy says request stays closed. Keep historical selection but show cancellation prominently and use consistent current status.

issues.title: Popups sometimes appear beneath page text or open out of bounds
issues.details: User reports recurring overlay stacking/placement bug. Inspect actual transition frames and settled state, parent stacking contexts, portal/top-layer use, clipping, flip/shift placement and nested overlays. Earlier transparent-frame observations were not confirmed; reproduce before choosing fix.
issues.verificationScope: Native search/category/contact overlays, admin contact modal and final terms/discard guards at recorded viewport sizes; not every possible popup/device combination.

issues.title: Search menu detached from its field
issues.details: Replaced viewport-wide absolute popup with anchored native top-layer popover; flips/clamps, follows scroll/resize, closes when anchor leaves view; keyboard scroll affects only panel.

issues.title: Category-specific request fields and mandatory unknown quantity/date
issues.details: One request form with title/category/body/city required; quantity/date optional. Optional fields visible, budget errors focus field; categories remain open for browsing.
issues.evidence: Actual local minimal request af38d827-6be5-4f8a-9c38-bd4bf6274601; 320px budget validation

issues.title: Personal and unverified accounts blocked from offers
issues.details: Registered client/company may respond, verification remains optional trust indicator; sealed offers/private columns/self/blocked/closed protections retained.
issues.evidence: 2356 SQL assertions; actual personal offer submitted and visible to both participants locally

issues.title: Populated unnamed optional product silently discarded
issues.details: Only entirely blank products ignored. Populated missing-name rows retain fields and focus marked required name before any save.

issues.title: Long service names hidden by +N and oversized chips
issues.details: All services/needs appear in editable rows; immediate draft updates, compact add and 44px removal controls.

issues.title: Offer form assumes manufacturing and fixed delivery deadline
issues.details: Visible freeform condition rows, optional offer execution deadline; actual agreed deal terms remain required.

issues.title: Mobile navigation CSS selector fails webpack purity rule
issues.details: Scoped global offset reset through local nav presence; production Turbopack build passed, final webpack check pending.

issues.title: Category rows too tall and disclosure replaced icons
issues.details: Shared category tree preserves icons, allchildren initial visibility, separate collapse control, alignedcounts and compactrows.

issues.title: Final deal terms could drop pending added condition
issues.details: Editableconditionrows save enteredtext; blankrows ignored. Back/X/Escape/backdrop all use the same discardguard; local320/390 verified.

issues.title: Registration stars did not match native required attributes
issues.details: Native/ARIArequired, consentstar, first-invalidfocus; duplicatephone gets inlineerrorandfocus.

issues.title: Empty product descriptions reserve redundant rows
issues.details: Compactedit/delete row and no emptyparagraph;15-product case checked320/390.

issues.title: Malformed admin deal cursor leaves a permanent loading state
issues.details: Parsing is caught; error offers Retry and First page. Live recovery and three regression tests passed.
